title: WhatsApp Integration: How to Set It Up (2026 Guide)
summary: WhatsApp integration varies by plan. The free Business app suits solo owners, while the Cloud API works for teams needing shared inboxes or automation.
body_markdown:
## Integrating WhatsApp through Cloud API


Strip it down and a WhatsApp integration's a link between a business phone number and your software. It's made through Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform, so your systems can send messages to customers and receive their replies. Each stage below leaves something working.


At developers.facebook.com, choose Create App, pick the Business type and attach it to your business portfolio. From the app dashboard, add the WhatsApp product.


Meta creates a test WhatsApp Business Account and a test number. You now have an app ID and a sandbox, which is enough to call the API but not enough to message real customers.


### Stage 2: Send the first test message


Open WhatsApp > API Setup. Copy the Phone number ID, add your own phone to the recipient list and confirm it with the code WhatsApp sends. Then run the sample request, which posts to the` /messages` endpoint with the` hello_world` template.


When a call that worked this morning returns an authentication error later, it is a stale token, not a bug in your code, because the token on this page is temporary.


### Stage 3: Register your number and create a permanent token


In WhatsApp Manager, add your real number and verify it by SMS or voice call. It can't already be active on the WhatsApp app.


Then, in Business Settings > Users > System users, create a system user, assign it the app, and choose Generate token with the` whatsapp_business_messaging` and` whatsapp_business_management` permissions. This token doesn't lapse, so store it in a secrets manager rather than in source control.


### Stage 4: Create and submit a message template


In WhatsApp Manager, open Message templates and choose Create template. Set the category (utility, marketing or authentication), the language and a body with numbered variables such as` {{1}}` . Submit it for review.


Until the status reads Approved, WhatsApp rejects any send outside a customer-initiated conversation, and a carelessly chosen category is the usual cause of a bounced review.


### Stage 5: Set up the webhook and receive replies


Under WhatsApp > Configuration, enter a public HTTPS callback URL and a verify token of your choosing. Your endpoint must answer Meta's verification request by returning the` hub.challenge` value it receives.


Then subscribe to the messages field. Delivery statuses and customer replies will arrive as POST requests to that URL.


You will find most integration failures here, in the run log rather than in the send call.


In the workflow view below, a Google Calendar event triggering a Gmail send shows what to expect from any builder. It displays each step's input and output data, and a failed run marked with its ID and an Edit Run button.


Read the failing step's output before changing anything.
